entities.summary: Brendan Arthur DuBois is an American writer in the genres of mystery fiction and alternate history. He is best known for his 1999 novel Resurrection Day. He was charged for possessing child pornography in July 2024 and sentenced to 3+1⁄2 to seven years in prison after he pleaded guilty in March 2025.
